name: Need Light
author: Addicting Games
description:
Need Light is a free mobile game. Prepare to embark on an electrifying adventure like no other! Introducing “Need Light” - a free mobile game that will ignite your imagination, challenge your reflexes, and spark joy in the hearts of players worldwide. Get ready to tap, drop, and plug your way to victory as you become the ultimate dangling electrical plug! In the whimsical world of Need Light, you find yourself in the shoes (or, should we say, prongs) of an intrepid electrical plug. Your mission is to tap your screen (or click that trusty mouse button on desktop) and skillfully navigate a swirling, ever-moving conveyor belt of sockets. Timing is everything, and it's up to you to drop down with pinpoint accuracy and plug yourself into those sockets as they stream by. Picture this: You're a plug; the world is your electrified oyster! With each successful connection, a surge of triumph courses through your virtual veins. You'll feel the joy of finding your place in the grand electrical symphony, completing circuits, and bringing power to the world. But beware, for the challenges you'll face along the way will test your reflexes and quick thinking. Can you adapt to the ever-increasing speed of the conveyor belt? Can you navigate the maze of moving sockets with finesse and precision?

Need Light is not just a game of skill and timing - it's a delightful experience that will brighten your day. Its vibrant, colorful visuals and playful animations create a world where mundane objects come to life, showcasing the magic that can be found in the simplest of things. Let the whimsy of the game's design and the lighthearted sound effects transport you to a realm where joy and laughter abound. This isn't just a game for the young. It's a game for the young at heart. Need Light is a mobile game that connects families, allowing parents and children to bond over shared moments of laughter and friendly competition.
